questions.explanation_english: Let the quantity sold at 18% profit be x kg. Then, the quantity sold at 73% profit is (100 - x) kg. The total profit can be calculated as follows: Profit from x kg at 18% = 0.18 * Cost Price * x. Profit from (100 - x) kg at 73% = 0.73 * Cost Price * (100 - x). The total profit is given as 29% of the total cost price. Setting up the equation: 0.18x + 0.73(100 - x) = 0.29 * 100. Solving this equation gives x = 20 kg. Therefore, the quantity sold at 73% profit is 100 - 20 = 80 kg. Hence, the answer is 20 kg.
